annotations.title: Launch an app, folder or document

description: Open an application (name, absolute path or Store app id, with its arguments), a folder or a document (absolute path) or a Settings page (ms-settings:...) and give the foreground back to the user. Returns the windows attributed to this launch, each with its proof: "process" (the process the shell returned), "folder" (a new Explorer window showing exactly that folder) or "application" (the requested application, started after the request: another instance started at the same moment could be taken for it; a Store app by its app id); other new windows come back as candidates (outcome unknown). Look at one before acting.

app.description: Application, folder, document or Settings page; a program may be followed by its arguments as a Windows command line ("C:\My Apps\app.exe" "C:\x\note.txt")

args.description: Arguments of a program (.exe or application name), as a Windows command line, quoted like on the command line; never a switch for a Chromium/Electron application

name: launch

status.description: Outcome: opened, verified, unknown, prompted, unmet, sent-unconfirmed…

windows.description: Windows attributed to this launch, with their proof
